name: auth
description: Forward-auth (identity headers of a configurable preset, believed only from the trusted proxy) -> users + roles, publicRoute / requireAuth / requireRole with a rule that every route declares one, service tokens (hash only, expiry, revoke), explicit dev mode. Fullstack: the UI's /api proxy carries the auth bridge. UI: the layer's useAuth reads GET /api/v1/me

env.description: Shared secret that proves a request came through the forward-auth proxy (header `x-auth-proxy-secret`, >= 16 chars). Fullstack: the UI server's auth bridge adds it; API alone: the proxy adds it. Forward-auth headers are believed only with it and/or AUTH_TRUSTED_PROXIES
Addresses / CIDR ranges of the reverse proxy (the TCP peer), comma-separated

Which headers the forward-auth proxy sets: authentik (default: X-Authentik-Username/-Uid/-Email/-Name/-Groups) or remote (Remote-User/-Email/-Name/-Groups). Single names: AUTH_HEADER_USERNAME, _UID, _EMAIL, _NAME, _GROUPS; AUTH_HEADER_GROUPS_SEPARATOR (default |)
1 = every request is the fixed dev user with all roles. Development only: the API refuses to start with it when NODE_ENV=production

next: {{kit.apiDir}}: local development — set AUTH_DEV_MODE=1 in .env (never in production); production — see "Auth" in .memory/docs/guides/usage.md for what the forward-auth proxy and the identity provider must be given (header preset: AUTH_HEADER_PRESET=authentik|remote)

env.description: The same value as the API's AUTH_PROXY_SECRET: the auth bridge of the /api proxy adds it for requests that came through the forward-auth proxy
Addresses / CIDR ranges of the forward-auth proxy as the UI server sees the TCP peer, comma-separated. Only requests from there have their identity headers passed on to the API; empty = none are
The same value as the API's: authentik (default) or remote — which identity headers the proxy sets
